translations.web: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.
translations.bsb: When he has filled his stomach, God will vent His fury upon him, raining it down on him as he eats.
translations.kjv: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
translations.asv: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath upon him, And will rain it upon him while he is eating.
